detail: Both 'Bluebird_33-0521B' and 'Victor_20-1864A' (Someday / Elton Britt) share rec_num 292.
resolution: Confirmed via discography sources as a genuine reissue (Bluebird -> RCA Victor, April 1946), not a duplicate entry. rec_num was a manually-typed legacy ID column and will not be carried into the new schema (Django assigns its own primary key), so the collision itself is moot going forward. Broader check found 6 more song/artist pairs with multiple physical releases on file, all confirmed legitimate (5 same-recording reissues + 1 genuine re-recording, Lionel Hampton's Flying Home for Victor 1940 vs Decca 1942). Schema gets a Recording.reissue_of self-FK to record the reissue relationship where known.
